heading: Heading
linkInvalid: This address is not a valid link.
aiPlaceholder: Ask anything or pick a request
aiLimit: You've asked the AI too often. Try again later.
aiKeys: Enter to accept, Escape to discard

report.label: Write as an intervention report
report.prompt: Rewrite this as an intervention report with these parts: context, work done, findings, recommendations. Keep every fact; invent none.

summary.label: Summary for a manager
summary.prompt: Summarize this in a few bullet points for a manager: status, problems, next steps.

actions.label: List the action items
actions.prompt: Turn this into a list of action items. Give who and when only where the text says it.

client.label: Write a client update
client.prompt: Rewrite this as a short, courteous update for the client: what was done, what remains, and what is expected from them.

risks.label: List risks and safety points
risks.prompt: List the risks, blockers and safety points this text raises, most serious first.

improve.label: Improve the wording
improve.prompt: Rewrite this to be clear, precise and professional, keeping every fact.

shorter.label: Make it shorter
shorter.prompt: Make this shorter and more direct, keeping every fact.

spelling.label: Fix spelling and grammar
spelling.prompt: Fix the spelling and grammar only; change nothing else.

keywords.callout: note info tip warning box highlight
